raw_response:
The issuer shows solid profitability (net margin ~12% and EBIT margin ~16%) and good balance-sheet cushioning (shareholders’ equity of ~42% of assets) along with adequate short-term liquidity (current ratio ~1.9). Leverage is moderate (liabilities ~58% of assets), but there isn’t enough information on debt burden/interest coverage to support a higher tier than low investment grade.  

DECISION: BBB+
